Score 2, if the patch has mostly correct fixes but is still not ideal (Weak Accept). Score 3, if the patch only makes edits that fix the warning with least impact on any unrelated segments of the original snippet (Strong Accept). If you find additions or deletions of code snippets that are unrelated to the desired fixes (think LLM hallucinations), it can be categorically scored 3(Strong Reject).
